import sys,json,csv,io,base64
sys.path.insert(0,'submission');sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
from campaign import audit
from common import parse_json
HDR=('type','id','revision','published','op','lease','event','probe','target','responder','result','service','attempt','payload')
def cap(rows):
 s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(HDR)
 for r in rows:w.writerow(r)
 return {'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(s.getvalue().encode()).decode()]}
def icmp(rid,pub,event,probe,target,resp,result):return ['icmp',rid,'0',str(pub),'put','h',str(event),probe,target,resp,result,'','','']
def app(rid,pub,event,target,result):return ['app',rid,'0',str(pub),'put','h',str(event),'',target,'',result,'t','0','']
rows=[icmp('i',50,1,'0/i1','2001:db8::1','2001:db8::1','echo'),app('a',50,1,'2001:db8::1','closed')]
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':10,'end':20,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],'services':[{'id':'t','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[5,10,20,30],'captures':[cap(rows)],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()))
for s in out['snapshots']:
 print(s['at'],s['ledger'],s['unbound_applications'],s['leases'][0]['state'],s['leases'][0]['internal'],s['leases'][0]['unresolved'])
EOF
